label: Film Stock
description: Film emulsion looks — each item commits to one stock's real palette, grain structure and highlight behavior.

items.name: portra-400
items.text: Kodak Portra 400 look, warm forgiving skin tones, fine tabular grain and highlights that roll off gently no matter how hard they are hit

items.name: ektar-100
items.text: Kodak Ektar 100 look, the finest grain of any color negative, punchy saturated reds and blues with landscape-grade sharpness

items.name: kodachrome-64
items.text: Kodachrome 64 look, dense archival reds and warm mid-century saturation, crisp contrast with near-invisible grain

items.name: kodak-gold-200
items.text: Kodak Gold 200 look, honeyed consumer-film warmth, gentle visible grain and a nostalgic amber summer cast

items.name: tri-x-400
items.text: Kodak Tri-X 400 black and white, gritty classic cubic grain, strong open midtones and the forgiving push-processed contrast of street reportage

items.name: ilford-hp5
items.text: Ilford HP5 black and white, soft forgiving contrast, smoky greys and modest grain that only tightens when pushed

items.name: delta-3200
items.text: Ilford Delta 3200 look, coarse expressive grain clumping in the shadows, deep blacks and soft halos swelling around night light sources

items.name: velvia-50
items.text: Fuji Velvia 50 slide-film look, supersaturated greens and blues, hard slide contrast crushing shadows to velvet black, landscape-postcard punch

items.name: provia-100f
items.text: Fuji Provia 100F look, neutral clean slide color with quiet precision and restrained contrast

items.name: pro-400h
items.text: Fuji Pro 400H look, airy minty pastels, luminous open highlights and skin leaning cool and porcelain

items.name: cinestill-800t
items.text: CineStill 800T look, tungsten-balanced cinema emulsion stripped of its anti-halation backing, teal shadows and red halation blooming around every bare light

items.name: polaroid-600
items.text: Polaroid 600 instant look, soft dreamy focus, milky lifted shadows, slightly crossed color and the white instant frame feel

items.name: aerochrome-ir
items.text: Kodak Aerochrome infrared look, foliage burning hot pink against cyan skies

items.name: superia-xtra
items.text: Fuji Superia look, cool green-leaning consumer color with 90s snapshot character and honest everyday grain

items.name: acros-100
items.text: Fuji Acros 100 black and white, satin micro-grain, luminous mid-grey tonality and famously clean long exposures that keep shadow detail after dark

items.name: vision3-500t
items.text: Kodak Vision3 500T motion-picture look, tungsten-balanced with enormous highlight latitude, neon rolling off softly into subdued cinematic grain

items.name: ektachrome-e100
items.text: Kodak Ektachrome E100 slide look, clean cool-neutral color with a signature clarity in the blues, tight grain and the crisp honest contrast of projected chrome

items.name: infrared-bw
items.text: black-and-white infrared look, foliage glowing snow-white, blue skies collapsing to near black and skin turning waxy-luminous, halation ghosting around the brightest leaves
